palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed source white/pale face, orange crest, purple flipper markings, dark claws and exact-black source-bounded eye edge in the corrected Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr343 model and native clips; PMDO registry supplies engine action names and event fields.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native quadruped/flipper crawl with foot/underside contact per frame; no duplicate endpoint.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own forward flipper strike/lunge; never ground-trim Physical Attack.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native upward open-mouth release pose; no projectile or effect asset inferred.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own quiet/rest cycle. Source eyes remain open-looking; no eyelids are invented.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native raised-flipper recoil, sampled away from idle endpoint.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own extended flipper sweep/strike, not a borrowed weapon animation.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two native lunge/strike cycles; PMDO XML has one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native pounce arc with extended side silhouette; front lift may be subtle, so no fake vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native crouched preparation/strain, reverse-sampled to recover; no effect invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native expression with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; no duplicate endpoint.
